name: Focus
author: RektyRowdyy
description: Apple-style Focus mode for Omarchy. Named profiles that block distracting websites and silence notifications — globally or per app — for a set duration or until you switch them off.

barWidget.description: Block distracting sites and silence notifications with one click.

schema.label: Show remaining time in the bar
schema.description: Display the countdown next to the icon while a timed focus session is running.
